a.title: Flying Roadsters can’t lift Tesla’s flat Q3 revenues

b.lede: On Tesla's earnings call Wednesday, Elon Musk made one of his patented pie-in-the-sky predictions that typically sends his fans into paroxysms of ecstasy: 5 million vehicle deliveries by 2030. "We were aiming for 5 million vehicles a year by approximately 2030," he said. "And I think we've got a good shot of achieving that goal." […]
b.title: Elon Musk says Tesla will sell 5 million cars by 2030 — math says otherwise
